description: Says whether stock exchanges are open now or at a given time (NYSE, NASDAQ, TSX, LSE, XETRA, EURONEXT, SIX, NSE, SSE, HKEX, TSE, ASX) and when they next open or close. Use it for scheduling around exchange sessions. Limits: regular sessions only; public holidays and half-days are not included.
name: market_hours
title: Stock Exchange Hours
